paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesikta Rabbati, piska “Anokhi Menachemkhem,” section 12.[^1]

notes.text: Chilfa’s heading title is abbreviated and retained as R'; of the South preserves דרומיה. The source names the Anokhi Menachemkhem piska and section12. No modern piska number is supplied or verified; the older expanded Anokhi Hu wording is not imported into the source quotation.
